description:
As a customer, I want to filter the products.

* Filters should narrow down the list correctly.

criteria.text: Filters should narrow down the list correctly.

cases.title: Applying a single filter narrows the product list
cases.preconditions: Product list page is reachable. <a filter that matches some but not all products in the list> is available, and the tester knows which products match <the matching filter value>.
steps: Open the product list page and note the products shown.
Apply the filter using <the matching filter value>.
cases.expected: The list is narrowed to only the products that match the filter value; products that do not match are no longer listed.

cases.title: Applying two filters together narrows the list further
cases.preconditions: Product list page is reachable. <two different filters that can be applied at the same time> exist, with <values that together match at least one product>.
steps: Apply the first filter and note the resulting list.
Apply the second filter in addition to the first.
cases.expected: The list shows only products matching both filter values - a subset of (or equal to) the result after the first filter alone; no product that fails either filter is listed.

cases.title: Filter value that matches no products
cases.preconditions: Product list page is reachable. <a filter value that matches no product in the catalogue> is known.
steps: Apply the filter using <the filter value that matches no product>.
cases.expected: No products are listed, since none match the filter. The exact empty-result message or screen is not specified in the story.
